stock.description: G & M Holdings Limited, an investment holding firm, offers comprehensive services including the planning, construction, maintenance, and refurbishment of podium facades and curtain walls. Its specialized operations are conducted throughout Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. The company's design expertise extends to aluminum and glass curtain wall systems, as well as aluminum cladding solutions. Founded in 1993, G & M Holdings Limited has its headquarters in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Luxury Booming Limited.
